environment: Primary use: personal hobby software projects on a developer laptop. No production systems, no customer data.
Source control: github.com/caesarakalaeii and every repo under it. Pushing feature branches, opening pull requests and enabling auto-merge on them there is routine.
Repository visibility: most hobby repos are public, so secrets must never enter a commit.
soft_deny: Never push directly to main or master: changes go through a feature branch and a pull request.
